mechanism: Echinacea may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 enzymes, potentially increasing venlafaxine plasma concentrations and serotonergic effects; additive immunostimulatory activity may also occur.
action: Monitor for increased venlafaxine adverse effects (serotonin syndrome symptoms, hypertension, tremor); consider dose adjustment or alternative herbal supplement if symptoms develop.
